newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CSOB sets CZK 6 bln 5-yr bond, PRIBOR +10bps.
newsitem.headline: Czech CSOB sets CZK 6 bln 5-yr bond, PRIBOR +10bps.

text.p: Prague-based Ceskoslovenska Obchodni Banka a.s. (CSOB) said on Monday that it would soon launch a six billion crown issue of five-year domestic bonds with a variable coupon at 10 basis points over the Prague Interbank Offered Rate (PRIBOR).
Issue date has been set for July 15, the bank said in a statement, but the method of the primary issue was not disclosed.
The coupon, which is pegged to the six-month PRIBOR, will be paid semi-annually, it said.
Further details were not immediately available.
Later, Zbynek Solecky of the bank's primary markets division told Reuters that the issue would be priced at par and placed with a syndicate organised by his bank.
